title: Hot Blood
overview: An evil minister lures local maidens to an abandoned fort where he uses and then kills them, leaving the villagers panic stricken as they try to unravel the mystery of the disappearances. To their horror they find the dead body of one of the girls and demand that the king do something about it. When the minister places the blame on an innocent young man, a masked avenger appears to help seek the truth behind the killings.
